title: Don’t encourage people to make contact with physical objects

statement.en: Exclude encourage people to make contact with physical objects from the applicable experience.
statement.ja: 該当する体験ではencourage people to make contact with physical objectsを避ける。

conditions: Apply within the platform, component, and section context identified by the source trace.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable NFC experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
rationale.ja: この指針は、対象AppleプラットフォームにおけるNFCの一貫性と使いやすさを支えます。

manual: Does the design satisfy “Exclude encourage people to make contact with physical objects from the applicable experience.” in the documented NFC context?

anti_patterns: Ignoring this guidance in a context where the source section applies.
positive_examples: A design review records how the implementation satisfies this rule and any source-scoped exception.

source.evidence_paraphrase: Exclude encourage people to make contact with physical objects from the applicable experience.

apple_native_rule: Exclude encourage people to make contact with physical objects from the applicable experience.
portable_interpretation: Preserve the user-centered intent after replacing Apple-specific platforms, components, and input conventions.
